verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Teams Export APIs that can export 1:1, group, meeting and channel messages, and keep user-deleted messages reachable for 21 days. That is adjacent to compliance and eDiscovery, but the pack never shows that retention policies or legal holds can be configured or enforced. Missing for 10: documented retention policy configuration and enforcement, legal hold capability, eDiscovery case and search tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
